acquisition method: Data dependent acquisition consisted of full MS scans in the range of m/z 370 to 1700
cleavage agent: proteins were in-gel digested using trypsin for subsequent mass spectrometry (MS) analysis
fractionation method: Samples for liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry analyses were separated by SDS-PAGE.
fragmentation method: fragmentation of the 15 most abundant multiply charged precursor ions by higher energy collisional dissociation recorded with resolution of 35,000.
instrument: peptides mixtures were separated on an Ultimate 3000 RSLCnano coupled to a Q-Exactive Plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
labeling: no labeling strategy is mentioned for sample-linked proteomics runs
